title: 十三张扑克牌正面底框
intendedUse: 52 张正面卡牌共用的无文字底框；点数、花色和布局由代码绘制
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: neutral background reference for a standard Anglo-American playing-card face. Create a single blank vertical poker card viewed straight on, with a flat clean white paper face, very thin neutral black outer keyline, tiny ordinary corner radius, and no shading except a faint edge antialiasing. Keep the interior completely empty and evenly white so software can place conventional black/red indices and pips. Transparent outside the card silhouette. Match the plain printed appearance of a traditional casino playing card; no game theme or decorative styling.
